brief.headline: Close the ₹14.26 L gap: bring Dextrose down to ₹66.48/KG (the price Sayaji already gives us)

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹66.48/KG on Dextrose Anhydrous IP — matching what Sayaji Industries gives us today
priceAsk.basis: We currently pay them ₹75.51/KG — 13.6% more than Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG for the same material. The market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose IP is ₹60–81/kg (typical ₹66–73/kg), so our target sits right in the fair middle of the market.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep the current 30 Days After Receipt; no reason to change it

brief.financialLeverage: Universal Starch publishes no financials, so we don't know their revenue, profit or how tight cash is for them. That means we lean on what we do know: we pay ₹59.65 L a year to them, and we already get ₹66.48/KG from Sayaji — proof the price exists. We have six credible alternate producers lined up (Tirupati Starch, Gulshan Polyols, Sanstar and three others), so we're not locked in. Without their numbers, the play is straightforward: show them the Sayaji price, show them the alternates, and ask them to match or explain why they can't.

evidence.point: We pay them ₹75.51/KG; Sayaji gives us the same Dextrose at ₹66.48/KG
Closing that gap saves us ₹14.26 L every year
Our annual spend with them is ₹59.65 L — enough volume to matter
Market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose IP is ₹60–81/kg, typically ₹66–73/kg — our target ₹66.48/KG is right in that band
India export price for Dextrose averages 42.95 ₹/kg — the material trades internationally far below what we pay

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Listed Indore maize wet-miller; makes Dextrose ANHYDROUS (IV-fluid grade) — exact form match; a lead to qualify (verify IP monograph CoA before switching)

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker; established dextrose/sorbitol supplier — a drop-in alternate to Sayaji; a lead to qualify (verify before RFQ)

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist (starch, dextrose) — growing capacity; a lead to qualify (verify before RFQ)

risks: Universal Starch publishes no financials — we can't see if they're stable or stretched, so watch for any signs of supply trouble (missed deliveries, quality slips) and move fast to qualify Tirupati or Gulshan if you see them
If they won't match ₹66.48/KG, be ready to split the volume: keep a smaller share with Universal Starch and shift the rest to Sayaji or trial one of the alternates — don't get stuck overpaying
They may claim their grade or service justifies the premium — ask for lab data or a side-by-side comparison; if they can't show a difference, the price gap has no reason to stay
We spend ₹59.65 L with them but have no idea how big that is to their business — if it's tiny for them, they may not care enough to move on price; be ready to walk and reallocate volume
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but we're paying you ₹75.51 a kilo when Sayaji gives us ₹66.48 for the same Dextrose — help us understand how we close that ₹14 lakh gap.
